name_en: Kujira no harihari nabe — whale meat and mizuna hot pot
summary_ja: かつお節などの出汁に醤油を合わせた鍋に、水菜と鯨肉をたっぷり入れて煮る冬の鍋。水菜を噛む「ハリハリ」という音が名の由来とされ、大阪・千日前で1967年に創業した鯨料理店が発祥と伝わる。
summary_en: Whale meat and plenty of mizuna simmer in a soy-seasoned bonito dashi — a winter hot pot. The dish's name is said to come from the crisp 'hari-hari' sound of biting into the mizuna, and it traces to a whale-meat restaurant founded in Osaka's Sennichimae in 1967.
source_title: 鯨のハリハリ鍋 大阪府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Osaka shiromiso zoni — round mochi in a white miso soup with root vegetables
summary_ja: 丸餅と輪切りの大根・人参、里芋を白味噌汁で仕立てる正月の雑煮。丸い具材には円満の願いが込められ、元日は白味噌、二日目は醤油仕立てに変える家庭も多く、「飽きない」大阪らしい風習と語られる。
summary_en: Round mochi simmers with sliced daikon, carrot, and taro in a white miso soup for New Year's. The round-cut vegetables are said to carry wishes for harmony, and many households switch to a soy-based soup on the second day — a custom framed as fitting for a city that prizes never growing 'bored.'
source_title: 白味噌雑煮 大阪府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Semba jiru — a clear soup of salted mackerel bones and daikon
summary_ja: 塩鯖のあらと大根を昆布出汁で煮て塩で味をととのえる潮汁。「船場煮」とも呼ばれ、奉公人を多く抱えた問屋街・船場の質素な商家料理として、魚の身をとった後のあらまで無駄なく使ったと伝わる。
summary_en: Salted mackerel bones and daikon simmer in kelp dashi, seasoned simply with salt — a clear soup also called semba-ni. It is said to descend from the frugal fare of Semba's wholesale merchant houses, which fed many live-in workers and let nothing of the fish go to waste.
source_title: 船場汁 大阪府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Hamo nabe — pike conger simmered with onion and potato, Senshu-style
summary_ja: 骨切りしたハモを、頭と骨でとった出汁に玉ねぎ・じゃがいもを合わせて煮る鍋。日本における玉ねぎ栽培発祥の地とされる泉州地域ならではの一品で、泉州玉ねぎの甘みが淡白なハモとよく合うという。
summary_en: Pike conger, bone-cut for its many fine bones, simmers in a broth made from its own head and bones, together with onion and potato. Said to be distinctive to the Senshu area, reputed birthplace of Japanese onion cultivation, its onions' sweetness is said to suit the mild fish well.
source_title: ハモ鍋 大阪府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
